# TOK-2291: Tokenization request schema validation

Status: In review. Owner: Dana Whitfield

## Scope
Validate inbound POST /v1/tokens payloads before they reach the vault service.

## Required fields
- card.number: PAN, 13 to 19 digits, must pass Luhn. Spaces and dashes allowed and stripped.
- card.exp: accepted formats MM/YY, MM/YYYY, MMYY, MM-YYYY. Month 01 to 12. Must not be in the past relative to the request time.
- card.holder_name: 1 to 80 chars, no digits.
- billing.address.postal_code: required when billing.address.country is US or CA.
- billing.address.country: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2.
- customer.id: required, string, max 64 chars.
- customer.email: optional, but if present must be a valid address.

## Masking
- Full PAN must never appear in validation errors, logs, or exception messages.
- Error output may show at most first 6 and last 4 digits.

## Errors
- Each error includes a JSON pointer path (e.g. /billing/address/postal_code) and a stable error code.

## Non-goals
- CVV handling is out of scope; the vault service owns it.
